findings.title: Server charge verify takes asset, recipient and amount from the echoed credential challenge, not from the configured currency and recipient
Client charge signs any challenge amount with no client-side maximum
Client charge has no cumulative spend budget across requests
Channel client signs a commitment to a cumulative amount chosen by the server
Close-state read in State.ts returns null on any RPC or decode error, so a closed or disputed channel reads as open
Channel client signs raw bytes returned by a contract address chosen by the challenge
Charge client signs a transaction for a challenge-chosen currency contract and network without an allowlist

findings.title: Client progress event formats amount with a hard-coded 7 decimals instead of the configured decimals
toBaseUnits silently truncates extra decimals and drops a leading minus sign
Push mode ignores sendTransaction ERROR status and polls for 60 seconds before reporting a generic timeout
Submission result status is ignored; rejected transactions are reported as a 60-second timeout
Close submission result is not checked for ERROR before polling, so a rejected close is reported as a 60-second not-found timeout
watchChannel silently monitors testnet when network and rpcUrl are omitted
Watcher turns an undecodable close or refund amount into 0 and reports it as a valid event
Channel server advances the stored cumulative before the close transaction is confirmed, so a failed close leaves a paid record with no settlement
Watcher re-delivers already-handled events when onEvent throws
